title: Credit Balance Hold and Refund Figures, Patient Financial Account
content:
A credit balance on a Patient Financial Account is governed by three per-class figures: the refund threshold, being the minimum credit balance that is refunded to the payer of the credit (a smaller credit remains on the account for future charges); the credit hold, being the calendar days a credit balance is held before refund so that pending insurance claims and crossovers can finish; and the refund processing time, being the business days (Monday to Friday, excluding group holidays) within which an approved refund is issued after the hold ends.

| Financial class (tier) | Refund threshold (USD) | Credit hold (calendar days) | Refund processing (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | 1.00 | 60 | 10 |
| Self-Pay Account | 1.00 | 30 | 10 |
| Medicare Part B Account | 1.00 | 60 | 10 |
| Medicare Advantage Account | 1.00 | 60 | 10 |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | 1.00 | 45 | 10 |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | 1.00 | 45 | 10 |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | 1.00 | 45 | 10 |

**Q. Which classes hold a credit longest?** The Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare Part B and Medicare Advantage accounts, at 60 calendar days. The three commercial classes hold for 45 days and the Self-Pay Account for 30.

**Q. Is the threshold or the processing time different anywhere?** No. The threshold is 1.00 and the processing time 10 business days on all seven classes.
